name: HSBC Premier World Mastercard® Credit Card

localized_names.en: HSBC Premier World Mastercard® Credit Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: $0 annual fee for primary cardholder and authorized users when the cardholder holds a Private Banking Account relationship or HSBC US employee status at the time of application and on each subsequent account anniversary date.

apr.notes: Variable Purchase APR 19.99% to 24.99% depending on creditworthiness; variable Balance Transfer APR 19.99% to 24.99%; variable Cash APR 28.99%. Maximum APR 29.99%. Transaction fee of $10 or 5% (whichever is greater) per balance transfer, check, or cash advance. Minimum interest charge $1.00.

credit_required.notes: Requires an existing U.S. HSBC Premier checking account to apply.

rewards.redemption_notes: Points can be redeemed for cash back as a direct deposit to an eligible HSBC Bank USA consumer checking or savings account, or as a statement credit. Rewards for Miles program allows transferring points into any of HSBC's 11 airline and 2 hotel partners' loyalty programs. Travel booked through HSBC Travel offers enhanced redemption value.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 50,000 Welcome Bonus Points, worth up to $625 in travel when booked through HSBC Travel, after spending $4,000 in the first 3 months of opening your card.

benefits.title: Streaming Statement Credit
benefits.description: Receive up to $60 in statement credits annually when you pay for your TV and radio streaming subscription with your Premier credit card.

benefits.title: Instacart+ Membership
benefits.description: Get up to $140 annually with Instacart+. When you sign up as a new member, receive 3 free months of Instacart+ and $10 off your second order each month.

benefits.title: Lyft Monthly Credit
benefits.description: Take 3 rides, and get a $5 Lyft App credit every month with your Premier credit card.

benefits.title: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Speed up airport screening with up to $85 towards Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, TSA PreCheck by Clear, or NEXUS application fees, once every 4.5 years.

benefits.title: Rewards for Miles
benefits.description: Rewards for Miles program allows you to transfer your points into any of HSBC's 11 airline and 2 hotel partners' loyalty programs.

benefits.title: Cellular Wireless Telephone Protection
benefits.description: Cellular Wireless Telephone Protection provides reimbursements up to $600 per claim if your cellphone is stolen or damaged.

benefits.title: Mastercard ID Theft Protection™
benefits.description: Mastercard ID Theft Protection™ and Identity Fraud Expense Reimbursement provide support and expense reimbursement if your identity is compromised through identity fraud.

benefits.title: Purchase Assurance
benefits.description: Purchase Assurance covers most purchases from damage or theft within 90 days of purchase up to $1,000.

other: Rewards for Miles: transfer points to 11 airline and 2 hotel loyalty programs.

notes: Available only to customers with an existing U.S. HSBC Premier checking account. Benefits valued by HSBC at over $1,200 in the first year and $600 per year thereafter. Issued by HSBC Bank USA, N.A.
